retrievalBaseline.rationale: Lexical retrieval is deterministic and mature enough to block decreases from the committed fixture/configuration baseline; baseline changes require a benchmark rationale.

retrievalRecallFloor.rationale: Issue #31 establishes 95% recall@5 as the initial target, but the current curated corpus is not yet baselined at that level.

taskSuccess.rationale: No task-success regression is the release target; enforcement waits for at least five stable matched agent pairs.

efficiency.rationale: A 20% median token or elapsed-time reduction is the initial context-heavy target; enforcement waits for five successful qualifying pairs.

helpfulRating.rationale: An 80% helpful rating is the initial opt-in aggregate target; enforcement waits for twenty voluntary ratings.
